document.title: Show list fields on the review skeleton
document.summary: `skeletonDocument` writes empty list arrays. The skill reads those fields from the skeleton.
document.why: [This session](source:s1) asks the skeleton to show the review shape so the producer does not open `references/example.md`.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 22
sources.gist: The producer should learn the review shape from the skeleton. The workflow should not send it to example.md.

lookFor: The published `skills/comprehende` copy still points at `references/example.md` and `review.schema.json`. [This session](source:s1) leaves that copy for a later release.
